title: CapabilityGraph v1
description: Runtime truth surface for capability. Seven layers: declared → registered → exported → reachable → contract_valid → safely_probeable → observed_callable. Includes IdentityPacket reference and TemporalPacket fields so a snapshot cannot masquerade as current truth. LIVE PROBE INVARIANT: mutating tools (consequence_class ∈ {MUTASI, DEPLOY}) MUST NOT be executed merely to prove callability. CapabilityCompiler either (a) inspects transport/schema only, or (b) uses a synthetic dry-run probe. UNREACHABLE/TIMEOUT is a typed capability state, never silently 'broken'.

ref.description: Server name, organ name, or agent ID.

declared.description: Tools advertised by repository/registry snapshot (static claim).

registered.description: Tools present in the server's own registered list (probe of capabilities).

exported.description: Tools the MCP transport actually lists via the active transport.

reachable.description: Tools the connector surface made available to the agent (subset of exported, may be empty).

contract_valid.description: Tools whose schema passed contract_valid check (BridgeProof of identity equivalence between connector surface and transport surface).

safely_probeable.description: Tools whose consequence_class ∈ {AKSES, HANTAR} — safe to probe without mutation risk.

observed_callable.description: Tools that responded to a live call probe at observed_at (measured reality). Includes ONLY safely_probeable tools — mutating tools are excluded by HARD INVARIANT.

mutating_tools.description: Tools identified as MUTASI/DEPLOYANCE — present in contract_valid set but EXCLUDED from observed_callable set because probing them would create consequences while measuring truth.

callability_evidence_method.description: How callability was verified WITHOUT execution (schema presence, transport response, etc.)

drift.description: Drift classifications computed from the seven layers above.

CONTRACT_VALID_NOT_SAFELY_PROBEABLE.description: Always non-empty when mutating tools exist. NOT a defect.

runtime_identity.description: IdentityPacket for the server/organ measured here.

observed_at.description: When the live probe ran. Snapshot not acceptable as substitute.

verdict.description: Overall verdict of the live probe.

probe_evidence_refs.description: Raw probe outputs (tools/list, call responses) backing the measurement.

schema_hash.description: Hash of schema surface for change detection.

allOf.description: HARD INVARIANT: mutating tools MUST NOT appear in observed_callable set. Capability proof must not create consequences while measuring truth.

observed_callable.description: Observed callable set must exclude mutating tool names.

allOf.description: HARD INVARIANT: callable_ratio ≤ safely_probeable_count / declared_count (mutating tools excluded from denominator as observable evidence).
